step1:dimcustomer.text:
{"task_id": "dimcustomer", "step": "recipe", "grain": "customerid", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM CustomerHistory ch
INNER JOIN TaxRate nat ON ch.C_NAT_TX_ID = nat.TX_ID
INNER JOIN TaxRate loc ON ch.C_LCL_TX_ID = loc.TX_ID
LEFT JOIN Prospect p ON ch.ActionType = 'NEW'
    AND upper(ch.C_L_NAME) = upper(p.LastName)
    AND upper(ch.C_F_NAME) = upper(p.FirstName)
    AND upper(ch.C_ADLINE1) = upper(p.AddressLine1)
    AND upper(ch.C_ADLINE2) = upper(p.AddressLine2)
    AND upper(ch.C_ZIPCODE) = upper(p.PostalCode)
WHERE ch.ActionTS = (SELECT MAX(ch2.ActionTS) FROM CustomerHistory ch2 WHERE ch2.C_ID = ch.C_ID)"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["inner join TaxRate nat for national tax rate", "inner join TaxRate loc for local tax rate", "left join Prospect p for demographic data"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": []}

step1:dimcustomer:retry.text: {"task_id": "dimcustomer", "step": "recipe", "grain": "customerid", "branches": [{"id": "b1", "from": "FROM CustomerHistory ch LEFT JOIN CustomerHistory ch_later ON ch.C_ID = ch_later.C_ID AND ch.ActionTS < ch_later.ActionTS INNER JOIN TaxRate nat ON ch.C_NAT_TX_ID = nat.TX_ID INNER JOIN TaxRate loc ON ch.C_LCL_TX_ID = loc.TX_ID LEFT JOIN Prospect p ON ch.ActionType = 'NEW' AND upper(ch.C_L_NAME) = upper(p.LastName) AND upper(ch.C_F_NAME) = upper(p.FirstName) AND upper(ch.C_ADLINE1) = upper(p.AddressLine1) AND upper(ch.C_ADLINE2) = upper(p.AddressLine2) AND upper(ch.C_ZIPCODE) = upper(p.PostalCode) WHERE ch_later.C_ID IS NULL"}], "combine": "none", "group_by": null, "decisions": {"joins": ["self anti-join on CustomerHistory to keep only the latest ActionTS per C_ID", "inner join TaxRate nat for national tax rate", "inner join TaxRate loc for local tax rate", "left join Prospect p for demographic data on latest NEW customer"], "stacked": false, "deduplicated": false, "aggregated": false}, "assumptions": []}

step2:dimcustomer.gender.text: {"task_id": "dimcustomer.gender", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(CASE WHEN upper(ch.C_GNDR) IN ('M','F') THEN upper(ch.C_GNDR) WHEN ch.C_GNDR IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'U' END AS CHAR(1))"}], "uses": ["ch.C_GNDR"], "class": "string_func", "assumptions": []}

{"task_id": "dimcustomer.phone1", "status": "answer", "expressions": [{"branch": "b1", "sql": "CAST(CASE
  WHEN ch.C_CTRY_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND ch.C_AREA_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND ch.C_LOCAL_1 IS NOT NULL THEN
    '+' || ch.C_CTRY_CODE_1 || ' (' || ch.C_AREA_CODE_1 || ') ' || ch.C_LOCAL_1 ||
    CASE WHEN ch.C_EXT_1 IS NOT NULL THEN ch.C_EXT_1 ELSE '' END
  WHEN ch.C_CTRY_CODE_1 IS NULL AND ch.C_AREA_CODE_1 IS NOT NULL AND ch.C_LOCAL_1 IS NOT NULL THEN
    '(' || ch.C_AREA_CODE_1 || ') ' || ch.C_LOCAL_1 ||
    CASE WHEN ch.C_EXT_1 IS NOT NULL THEN ch.C_EXT_1 ELSE '' END
  WHEN ch.C_AREA_CODE_1 IS NULL AND ch.C_LOCAL_1 IS NOT NULL THEN
    ch.C_LOCAL_1 ||
    CASE WHEN ch.C_EXT_1 IS NOT NULL THEN ch.C_EXT_1 ELSE '' END
  ELSE NULL
END AS VARCHAR(30))"}]}
